sources.intro: Catavento brings together public information from many places. Every record shows where it came from and when it was checked. This page lists every source, what we use from it, how often we check it, and the credit we show.
sources.tierGreenText: Public directories, openly licensed data and official services. We show the facts with a credit and a link.
sources.tierAmberText: Public but run by volunteers, without published terms, or sensitive to traffic. We take only facts and short labels, link to the full content, check rarely, and tell the owner what we use.
sources.tierRedText: Their terms don't allow automated collection, or the content needs a login. We collect nothing and only link to them.
sources.creditNote: Words in italics are filled in for each record, for example the club's name.
sources.changesText: If you look after one of these sources and would like us to change or stop using anything, tell us and we'll act on it, usually within 24 hours.

status.intro: Catavento collects public information automatically on a schedule. Each check downloads the source, compares it with the last copy, and only updates the site if nothing looks wrong. This page shows how the latest check went for each source.
status.manualText: Everything else on the Sources page is added or checked by hand, or only linked to.
status.notesExplainer: Notes list records we couldn't read fully. Those records still appear, with a link to the official details.

states.unchanged: No changes since the last check
states.failed: Check failed; showing the last good copy

guard.accepted_first_run: First collection, so there was nothing to compare with
guard.blocked_drop: Held back: more than 20% of records disappeared at once
guard.blocked_invalid: Held back: more than 10% of records couldn't be read

status.timeZoneNote: Times are shown in Sydney time.

bot.intro: CataventoBot is the program that collects public information for Catavento. It is built to be a polite visitor: it takes only short facts, checks rarely, and stays away from anything it is asked not to read.
bot.identityText: Every request it makes carries this user agent:

rules.robots: It reads each website's robots.txt first and obeys it. If robots.txt can't be read because of a server error, it doesn't visit.
rules.pace: It makes one request at a time to each website, at least 3 seconds apart.
rules.rarely: It checks each source on a schedule of days or weeks, not continuously. If a file hasn't changed, nothing is updated.
rules.noLogin: It never logs in, never sends cookies, and never fills in forms.
rules.facts: It takes facts and short labels, such as names, coordinates, wind directions and links. It never copies descriptions, articles or photos.
rules.guard: If a source suddenly looks very different, the update is held back for a person to check.

bot.scheduleHeading: What it collects, and how often
bot.scheduleText: These are the sources it currently collects from. The Sources page lists everything Catavento uses, including what is only linked to.
bot.noneYet: Nothing is being collected automatically at the moment.
bot.optOutText: To stop CataventoBot visiting your website, add these lines to your robots.txt. It will stop at its next scheduled check.
bot.optOutContact: Or email us and we'll stop, usually within 24 hours. We can also remove anything already collected from your site.
